text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... My thanks.
I was just hoping to take a breather."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lately... perhaps because I have so much on my mind,
I haven't quite been in top form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How should I make the most efficient use of my time until the next race...?
Have I done enough to calculate the formula for victory?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Equations... Right, I wonder if Ticket was able
to use the formula I taught her on her makeup exam...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And Taishin too! I haven't seen her since this morning.
Could she be sick in bed?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You've got such a difficult personality, as always.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm not slacking off.
...This is a short break before the Student Council meeting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, what a coincidence.
We also came here to take a breather.
choice_data_list: Then, shall the three of us visit the shrine next time?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That is—no, but...
Dragging you along right before a meeting would be... a bit much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Not really.
I have that much time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thank you, both of you.
This should be a nice break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of us prayed at the shrine, and...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What're you laughing at all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No... Praying side-by-side like this just
brought back memories of that day."

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian, what did you wish for this year?

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: "I wish I can get real fast just like Big Sis this year!" ...What about Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu... "May I keep running with Brian, forever and ever"... it says!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Something that far back, I've forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
I can remember it as if it were yesterday, you know?
choice_data_list: That was a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Not only that,
I was also reminded of the wish I want to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, how simple.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a nice change of pace, Biwa Hayahide's condition seemed to have fully recovered!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It's no use.
The more I try not to think about it, the more I can't stop thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It's no use.
Once Big Sis gets like this, she won't calm down for a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! I'm worried about you too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you taking proper care of yourself at the academy?!
Don't tell me you've been living an unhealthy lifestyle—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Don't run away, listen to me, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No!
I told you we have a student council meeting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide couldn't shake her worries even while praying,
failing to get the change of pace she needed...
